record.question: Which of the following is one of the most important counselling points for a patient with hypertension?
options: Take antihypertensive medication daily at the same time, even if feeling normal
Avoid all physical activity to prevent increase in blood pressure
Take medication only when experiencing symptoms like headache or dizziness
Stop antihypertensive medication once blood pressure becomes normal
record.explanation: Answer A: Take antihypertensive medication daily at the same time, even if feeling normal. Hypertension is often asymptomatic; taking prescribed medicine consistently is important even when the patient feels normal. Source/context note: Dose timing should follow the prescription; do not alter therapy without the prescriber. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/hypertension. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
